item.title: Single optical element combines soft X-ray imaging and spectroscopy
item.description: An international research team from Germany, Switzerland and Japan has demonstrated in a recent study that a single reflection zone plate (RZP) can perform both soft X-ray imaging and resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) mapping.
